backtest_protocol.execution_model: SEC S-8 employee-equity events are read from EDGAR submissions cache recent filings for forms S-8 and S-8 POS. The signal date is the filing date unless the SEC acceptance timestamp is after 16:00, in which case it is the next trading day. Candidates must show signal-day price absorption before next-open paper entry: non-negative daily return, return minus SPY >= 0.5%, close location >= 0.56, volume ratio >= 0.75, realized vol <= 12%, ret20 excess vs SPY >= -5%, price >= $10, and ADV20 >= $50M. Paper entry is the next available open with entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

2_history_check.exp-20260616-015: Accepted SBC burden improvement as a raw Companyfacts dilution-quality source. This run tests a filing event plus price absorption, not SBC/revenue thresholds or shared SBC helper tuning.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-017: Rejected per-share SBC net of buybacks. This run avoids per-share, buyback, and share-count ratio refinements.
2_history_check.exp-20260617-011: Rejected SEC contract-economics text. Its regex explicitly excluded equity incentive terms from contract parsing, so this run tests the event-form family directly rather than SEC text semantics.
2_history_check.exp-20260617-023: Rejected SEC offering/prospectus price absorption. This run does not retry 424B/S-1/S-3/F-3 financing forms or their thresholds; it tests S-8 employee benefit plan registration as a different SEC submissions form family.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: S-8 employee-equity registration is a broad free SEC submissions event with adequate three-window coverage and is not included in the rejected exp-20260617-023 offering/prospectus form list. The mechanism is that employee-equity capacity can be a growth/talent investment signal when price absorbs dilution, but the likely disconfirmer is routine filing noise or overlap with the accepted SBC burden-improvement source.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT SEC S-8/S-8 POS events, acceptance-time signal date, price-absorption gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
